newsitem.title: MEXICO: Abaco sharply down on financial woes.
newsitem.headline: Abaco sharply down on financial woes.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican financial group Abaco were sharply down in late trade on Monday on market fears over the group's financial situation, analysts and traders said.

"Abaco's situation is not good, and still depends on the capitalization program at its banking division (Confia). They have some problems with reserves and maybe that is where investors' concerns lie," a Mexico City equity analyst said, who requested anonymity.
Officials at Abaco were not available for comment.
Abaco B shares were at the head of the prominent decliners' list in late trade, down 14 centavos to 84 centavos.
Some traders nonetheless put the fall in Abaco's share prices down to speculation.
"Abaco has been the main buyer, it seems they have a fund for a share buyback," a dealer said.
